description: Figure 5(a) displays training loss curves for various methods plotted against the number of iterations on a linear x-axis ranging from 0 to 140,000, with tick labels at intervals of 20,000. The y-axis represents the loss value, scaled linearly from 2.4 to 3.4. The plot contains five distinct lines, each corresponding to a different method: Vanilla (purple, dash-dotted), StrmLLM (n=64) (blue, dashed), StrmLLM (n=380) (orange, solid), SepLLM (n=64) (green, dash-dotted), SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, solid), and SepLLM (n=128) (cyan, dash-dotted). All lines begin at a loss value of approximately 3.2 and exhibit a downward trend as iterations increase. The Vanilla method starts at 3.2 and decreases to approximately 2.7. StrmLLM (n=64) begins at 3.2 and decreases to approximately 2.6. StrmLLM (n=380) begins at 3.2 and decreases to approximately 2.5. SepLLM (n=64) begins at 3.2 and decreases to approximately 2.5. SepLLM (n=64, H/T) begins at 3.2 and decreases to approximately 2.4. SepLLM (n=128) begins at 3.2 and decreases to approximately 2.5.
